name: almanac
description: Durable records that outlive a session, one file per record, written only through their scripts: project and global todos, notes (a pointer plus metadata, in place of Claude Code auto-memory), the project's ordered tasklist, pending product decisions for the operator, and ccpraxis bug reports. Bundles /almanac:todo, /almanac:note, /almanac:task, /almanac:decision, /almanac:bug-report and /almanac:bug-triage, the almanac dispatcher and doctor, and hooks that deny direct edits to the stores.
